A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] '''Selkath''' [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] served in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During an [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engagement]] with a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] wielded a [[protosaber]] with a [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]], slashing one of the [[B-series battle droid/Legends|droids]] across the torso with the saber and using [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] to push it into its squadmates. The Jedi was blue-skinned, had black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and wore brown and gray [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]].<ref name="JATM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Selkath Jedi appeared in an image created for the ''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]'', a resource guide for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2009]]. The image was used to demonstrate a combat technique called the "Pushing Slash."<ref name="JATM" />
